properties.description: Inputs / Active / Closed. Active has independently scrollable Waiting / In progress / Queued / Backlog with splitters. New/Later/time grouping where agreed, explicit acknowledgement resets on update, recency-only time groups, inherited optional priority elsewhere. Compact two-row cards with creator avatar, input disposition/type, task stage and priority controls. Reusable typed query/autocomplete with saved flat queries, same-width popup and collapsed toolbar search.
properties.title: Deliver the accepted Activity board and query experience
